name: Dhruv Patil

job_alert_sources.name: Glassdoor
job_alert_sources.freshness: Each listing shows its age (Just posted / 5h / 1d / 12d); keep Just posted, hours, 1d, 2d or 3d.

job_alert_sources.name: Hunt UK Visa Sponsors
job_alert_sources.freshness: Digest of the latest jobs at sponsoring employers; it arrives only every few days, so read any digest from the last 7 days and rely on the duplicate check.

job_alert_sources.name: Newcastle University
job_alert_sources.freshness: Weekly digest; read any digest from the last 7 days and rely on the duplicate check.

avoid_roles: Data Analyst / BI / Data Science roles whose essential criteria are strong SQL or Python
Finance roles needing an accounting qualification (CIMA, ACA, ACCA)
locations: Anywhere in the UK, including Scotland (happy to relocate)

visa.notes: Time-limited right to work until January 2028. Contracts ending by then need no sponsor. For permanent roles, a licensed sponsor is strongly preferred; a non-sponsor permanent role is still shown but scored lower and flagged.

skill_limits.about: What the owner can honestly claim. Never score or write above this level.
skill_limits.sql: Working knowledge only (select, filter, join, group by). Counts as half-evidenced when an advert asks for SQL, and as NOT met when it asks for strong/advanced SQL.
skill_limits.python: Used in degree projects with AI assistance; cannot write it unaided. Counts as NOT met when Python is an essential requirement.
skill_limits.strengths: Requirements, business rules, process mapping, stakeholder work, user acceptance testing, Power BI, Excel, defining and delivering internal tools with AI coding assistants.

web_discovery.about: Jobs found on the web through Firecrawl, in addition to alert emails. See CLAUDE.md step 4b.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Junior Business Analyst, whole UK

web_discovery.watchlist_query: "{employer}" careers ("business analyst" OR "product analyst" OR "junior business analyst" OR "graduate analyst") UK
web_discovery.watchlist_note: Large employers with regular business analyst hiring. Sponsorship no longer matters; the list is kept for coverage.

goal: Paid UK business analyst experience before the visa ends in January 2028. Fixed-term contracts of 12 months or less that end by January 2028: any employer is fine, sponsorship is irrelevant. Permanent roles: strongly prefer licensed Skilled Worker sponsors, because they are used to hiring people on visas and are less likely to pass over a time-limited right to work (and it keeps the option to stay open).
